description: This file contains the implementation of a workflow editor using jsPlumb, including class definitions, methods for managing activities and connections, and module imports.

classes.name: s
classes.description: A class representing the workflow editor with methods for managing activities, connections, and state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the workflow, including activities and transitions.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current workflow state into a JSON string.

methods.name: saveLocalState
methods.description: Saves the current workflow state to session storage.

methods.name: loadLocalState
methods.description: Loads the workflow state from session storage.

methods.name: getActivity
methods.description: Retrieves an activity by its ID.

methods.name: updateConnections
methods.description: Updates the visual connections between activities based on the workflow data.

methods.name: updateCanvasHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the height of the workflow canvas based on activity positions.
